literal_meaning: to roll around or tumble repeatedly
example_sentences_in_bangla: ঘুম আসছে না, বিছানায় গড়াগড়ি দিচ্ছি।
চিন্তায় ভরা মনে রাত কাটাচ্ছি গড়াগড়ি দিয়ে।
example_sentences_in_english: I can't sleep; I'm tossing and turning in bed.
I'm spending the night rolling around in worry.
note: Commonly used to describe physical discomfort from sleeplessness in everyday Bengali speech.
